name: @repo/context-core
description: Pure library for the OuterLayer context layer: per-kind frontmatter schemas + round-trip serialization, mcp.json validation + secret lint, and tree-diff for incremental sync, on top of the classifier and taxonomy re-exported from @outerlayer/context-format. No I/O, no Supabase, no fetch/fs — operates purely on in-memory path lists and file contents so it bundles into the dashboard, the gateway, or a future CLI unchanged.
